attributes.title: Datasets, Codebooks, & Analysis Scripts
attributes.description: Each study contains data, codebooks, and analysis code. We recommend zip downloading the entire folder. Folders also contain data, codebooks, analysis scripts related to model and stimulus construction. Much of the stimulus construction process requires a license to FaceGen's Software Development Kit (SDK), please contact the authors for image rendering code.
